title: Reset a VPN token
text: VPN token reset: verify the caller's identity on a video call, then reset the token in the identity portal. Takes 10 minutes.

title: Printer offline
text: Printer offline: power cycle the printer, check the switch port, then update firmware to 4.3. Firmware 4.2 drops off the network after 30 days.

title: Laptop will not charge
text: Laptop not charging: try a second charger, check the charging port, and book a hardware check if the battery drains while plugged in.

title: Request access to a shared drive
text: Shared drive access: the request needs approval from the drive owner. The helpdesk grants access within one working day of approval.

title: Wi-Fi drops in meeting rooms
text: Wi-Fi drops: note the room and time, forget and rejoin the network, and report the access point label printed on the ceiling unit.
